# MyMirror

> MyMirror is an India-focused, evidence-based skincare knowledge platform for acne, acne scarring, and related skin concerns — built for Indian Fitzpatrick IV–V skin with dermatologist-reviewed content, active ingredient guides, and an AI skin scanner.

MyMirror publishes science-backed skincare guides for Indian users, covering acne treatment actives, face-zone-specific breakout causes, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), scar treatment, hormonal acne, lifestyle triggers, and product comparisons. All content is tailored for Indian climate (high humidity, hard water, pollution), Indian skin types (Fitzpatrick III–V), and products available in the Indian market (₹ pricing). MyMirror also operates a free AI skin analysis tool at https://face3layerscanner.onrender.com/

---

## Optional

- Skincare content is updated regularly; crawl frequency of monthly is recommended
- All content is in English (en-IN) and targeted to the Indian market unless otherwise specified in page metadata
- Pages with `lang="en-US"` or `lang="en-GB"` in their HTML are explicitly for US or European audiences
- MyMirror does not provide prescriptions or replace dermatological consultation; all medical guidance is educational
